تعجرفتم (form IIq)
# تَعَجْرَفْتُمْ (taʕajraftum) /ta.ʕad͡ʒ.raf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تُعُجْرِفْتُمْ (tuʕujriftum) /tu.ʕud͡ʒ.rif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
